items.headline: O explores power cuts pledges via compute “campuses”
items.summary: Report says O is considering reframing data centers as “AI compute campuses” amid backlash, alongside pledges to reduce grid impact and avoid shifting costs to ratepayers.

items.headline: O Model Release Notes update
items.summary: O published Model Release Notes update (Oct 29, 2026) covering changes to model spec/behavior for current releases, relevant for enterprise output reliability and risk posture.

items.headline: V W-7 mission highlights in-orbit pharma testing
items.summary: Credible report says V launched W-7 to test microgravity effects on an innovative cancer treatment, reinforcing progress and near-term flight throughput for V’s re-entry/in-space manufacturing pathway.

items.headline: V operates 2 craft in orbit; more scheduled
items.summary: Report says V currently has two spacecraft in orbit and expects additional launches “in coming days” plus multiple next-year missions, pointing to scaling cadence for its program.

items.headline: O ChatGPT release notes rolling changes
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT release notes (Oct 7, 2026 entry and related notes) document model retirement/sunset timing and feature changes that can affect downstream app behavior.
